The '''Galactic Library''' was a library in existence during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It dispatched research teams across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on assignments, such as [[Hacken Berge]]'s efforts to research the [[Promised Ones]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].
